items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Harry and I were in the same class in school

ctx.x: No. Never lived on Tremont Street in my life. My family lived in... Well, in Boston we lived on Warwick Street. Then we moved to Marble Street. And after Marble Street, we moved out in Roxbury to Harrishaw(?) Street.

Now, while I was on Warwick Street, that's when I was going to grammar school, the Sherwin Grammar School. Around about that time... This was, oh, let me see, in the years... Quite a few years back there. Anyway, that's when I met Howard Johnson, Johnny Hodges, Harry Carney. Harry and I were in the same class in school
